summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Cheer Holding, Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on July 7, 2026. Shareholders re-elected two Class I directors, ratified the auditor, approved a share capital increase (from ~$0.5M to ~$7.5M) by creating 46,666,667 new Class A ordinary shares, and adopted a 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. No merger, tender offer, or special situation is involved; these are routine governance proposals. The filing incorporates by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms or unusual events are present.
